newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish wood firm Grajewo eyes May 6 bourse debut.
newsitem.headline: Polish wood firm Grajewo eyes May 6 bourse debut.

text.p: Polish chipboard maker Grajewo SA could start trade on the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse as early as May 6, the firm's president said on Monday.

"We will likely start trade on May 6, and though it (the date) is not fixed yet our debut should come after the long weekend," Jan Kowalski told a news conference. He told Reuters the debut could come as late as May 14.
Polish markets are closed on May 1 and 2.

Kowalski said the bourse last week cleared the firm for trade on the parallel market rather than the main floor, as originally planned, because the firm's share capital was at 6.6 million below the seven million zloty threshold.
He said Grajewo would raise the nominal value of its shares at its shareholders meeting this quarter so that the firm could reach the main market in about three months.
The 550,000-share January initial public offering of Grajewo, or Zaklady Plyt Wiorowych w Grajewie SA, was seven times subscribed.
